intro: {{nameA}} in {{cityA}} and {{nameB}} in {{cityB}} are two {{course}} options students often weigh together. This page compares their recorded fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
IIM Calcutta vs JIS College of Engineering is not a single winner. IIM Calcutta has a recorded NIRF 2025 #7, and JIS College of Engineering has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: IIM Calcutta vs JIS College of Engineering for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIM Calcutta if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #7, and a 2025 flagship package record of ₹34.23 LPA, in a public MBA / PGDM setting at Kolkata.
Choose JIS College of Engineering if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹4.26 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Kalyani.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹12.5 lakh as a tuition figure for Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM) Economics & Strategy at IIM Calcutta. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹4.26 lakh as a tuition figure for MBA Finance at JIS College of Engineering. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: IIM Calcutta's latest recorded flagship year here is 2025, with an average of ₹34.23 LPA and a highest package of ₹145 LPA on Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM) Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

JIS College of Engineering's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹12 LPA on MBA Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2025 and 2023, so the packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: IIM Calcutta is listed on our records with CAT, GMAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.

JIS College of Engineering is listed on our records with CAT, JEMAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: IIM Calcutta is in {{cityA}}, West Bengal, and JIS College of Engineering is in {{cityB}}, West Bengal. A move between these cities should be part of the decision, not only the fee or the rank.
IIM Calcutta is listed as a public institute and JIS College of Engineering as a private institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you prefer a public MBA / PGDM campus and the reservation or fee pattern that often comes with it, IIM Calcutta is the better fit on our records.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether JIS College of Engineering's recorded ₹4.26 lakh or IIM Calcutta's ₹12.5 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, IIM Calcutta or JIS College of Engineering?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for IIM Calcutta vs JIS College of Engineering?
faqs.answer: see official sources for IIM Calcutta; our records list ₹4.26 lakh for JIS College of Engineering on MBA Finance. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for IIM Calcutta and JIS College of Engineering?
faqs.answer: IIM Calcutta's latest recorded flagship year here is 2025, with an average of ₹34.23 LPA and a highest package of ₹145 LPA on Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM) Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do IIM Calcutta and JIS College of Engineering accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CAT, GMAT for IIM Calcutta, and CAT, JEMAT for JIS College of Engineering. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Where are IIM Calcutta and JIS College of Engineering located?
faqs.answer: IIM Calcutta is in Kolkata, West Bengal, and JIS College of Engineering is in Kalyani, West Bengal. Factor travel and hostel costs into the comparison.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
